newsitem.title: USA: KCBT wheat ends mixed in thin volume.
newsitem.headline: KCBT wheat ends mixed in thin volume.

text.p: KCBT hard red winter wheat futures ended mixed on Wednesday with nearbys down in line with losses in CBOT December, traders said.
Volume was said to be very light, which contributed to the volatile action, they said.
"We went up to our two-week highs and then we went right back down," a trader said. "The key is poor price action. I think people are waiting to see what the report will show."
USDA on Friday will release its monthly U.S. crop production report. Traders said the market was leery of surprises in the corn and soybean production figures.
There was talk that yields were deteriorating as harvest progressed which raised doubts about the crop size.
Volume was estimated at 17.055 million bushels, KCBT reported.
"We have not been posting volume anywhere close to 20 million bushels," a trader said, adding that 20 million was considered average.
Wheat closed three cents per bushel higher to 2-1/2 cents lower with December down 2-1/2 at $4.39 a bushel.
